title: Subtraction Nim with Continuous Parameters
summary: When $S$ is a finite set of positive integers, we can consider classical Subtraction Nim with $S$ as the set of removable numbers. Even when $S$ consists of three elements, many questions remain unanswered. For example, we do not have a period formula of the Nim value. In this paper, we generalize $S$ to be a finite set of positive real numbers. We found that in some regions, we can give concrete formulae for the period and the Nim value function.
